page.text:
A set is taken as undefined; the only thing one may ask of it is which
sets belong to it. For sets $x$ and $X$, either $x \in X$ or
$x \notin X$, and this membership relation carries all the information a
set has to offer. The axioms below are collected as the defining
conditions of what it means to be a set.
